notes: A nationwide web-panel survey of 1,500 HCPs with percentages and Pearson chi-square tests on knowledge scores by region, provider type, years in practice and cases managed (Table 2). The outcome is provider knowledge rather than a health outcome, so data_focus is yes at medium confidence for the judgment reader to check. There is no regression, adjustment or CI judged against a fixed value; the 5% CI has no stated method.
view_issues: Discussion says 78% of providers had 'little to no knowledge', but 674 (78%) is the share who diagnosed no patients; scores of 0 or 1 are about 73%. Table 1 'Not too confident' 35.3% has CI 32.9–33.7, which excludes the estimate. Table 2 flags West and two experience rows as p<0.05 against referents, while the text calls region and years not significant.
